nfl.oneThing: Lamar Jackson is out for the Ravens' Sunday game against the Bengals with an ankle sprain, and Tyler Huntley will start.

headlines.title: Josh Jacobs is back for the Packers
headlines.summary: Josh Jacobs has been cleared to play at Detroit on Sunday after six weeks on the commissioner's exempt list. The NFL's conduct investigation is still active, and any suspension could be as long as the six games he has already missed, which would be credited. Green Bay has had the league's worst rushing offence, averaging 59.8 yards a game without him.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Packers (4–2, sixth in the NFC) get their leading rusher back for a divisional game against the Lions (3–2).

headlines.title: Ravens lose Lamar Jackson and Tavius Robinson
headlines.summary: Lamar Jackson is out against the Bengals with an ankle sprain, so Tyler Huntley starts. Tavius Robinson has a season-ending pectoral injury. Robinson had a 72% defensive snap share and led the defence with 3.5 sacks. Baltimore will lean on young edge depth, including rookies Zion Young and Ethan Burke.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Ravens (4–2, seventh in the AFC) are losing their starting quarterback for this game and a key pass rusher for the season.

headlines.title: Eagles' top two receivers are out
headlines.summary: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks have both been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys. Smith has dealt with hamstring issues since the summer and did not practise this week. Wicks has an ankle injury and will miss his first game with the Eagles. Dallas Goedert is expected to play.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Eagles (2–4) have lost four straight, and they will be without their top two receivers against Dallas (2–4).

headlines.title: Giants lose Tremaine Edmunds for the season
headlines.summary: The Giants have placed linebacker Tremaine Edmunds on injured reserve with a torn chest muscle. He was the team's leading tackler through six games, with 50 tackles. Safety Jevon Holland has been ruled out with a concussion, and Brian Burns and Chauncey Golston are out for the season. Paulson Adebo has been activated and could start against the Texans.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Giants (3–2–1) are thin on defence, and Micah McFadden steps in at linebacker.

teamNews.title: Raiders mourn Pete Banaszak
teamNews.text: Former Raiders running back Pete Banaszak has died at 82. He played his entire career with the team, led the NFL with 16 rushing touchdowns in 1975, and won Super Bowl XI, the franchise's first Super Bowl.

teamNews.title: Rams arrive battered
teamNews.text: The Rams are 2–4 and on a two-game skid. Davante Adams (hamstring, out 6 to 10 weeks), Kobie Turner (groin, out 4 to 6 weeks), Poona Ford and Blake Grupe are all out.

teamNews.title: Mendoza could be pushed into the starting role
teamNews.text: CBS Sports says Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 overall pick, was always meant to sit behind Kirk Cousins. The Raiders may soon be pressed to start him.

contextCard.title: How the NFL trade deadline works
contextCard.body: The trade deadline is the cut-off during the regular season after which teams can no longer trade players with each other. Until then, teams can trade players and picks at any time, and deals often shape the playoff push. Teams can still sign free agents after the deadline.

headlines.title: Paolo Banchero out for multiple weeks
headlines.summary: The Magic have confirmed a low-grade right high ankle sprain but have not released an official timeline. Sources told ESPN he will miss multiple weeks. A sprain of this grade typically takes around 4 to 6 weeks to recover.
headlines.whyItMatters: Orlando is 0–2 and 14th in the East, and it will be without its star for at least the start of the season's next stretch.

headlines.title: Cooper Flagg has a mild shoulder sprain
headlines.summary: Cooper Flagg, the reigning Rookie of the Year, had an MRI that showed a mild left shoulder sprain. He picked it up on a flagrant foul by Aaron Nesmith in Friday's win over the Pacers. Flagg will miss the home opener against the Spurs and will be reevaluated next week. Dallas is 1–1 after beating Indiana 121–105.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Mavericks are missing their young star for at least the next game, against a Spurs team that is also 0–2.

headlines.title: LeBron James sits with sciatica
headlines.summary: LeBron James missed the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain and sciatica. It is his first missed game of the season, and the first of a back-to-back. The same issue kept him out for the first 14 games of last season. Joel Embiid is not on the injury report.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia is 2–0 and third in the East. Keeping James healthy matters more than a single game this early.

headlines.title: Jayson Tatum says there's no beef with Jaylen Brown
headlines.summary: Jayson Tatum says there is no feud with his former teammate Jaylen Brown, saying the pair's accomplishments should be the focus. Tatum has backed that up on the court: he scored 36 points with 9 rebounds and 7 assists in the Celtics' win over the Knicks.
headlines.whyItMatters: Boston is 1–1 and seventh in the East, and Tatum's comments close off a story that could have distracted the team.

recaps.text: The Warriors looked in control before everything fell apart in the final four minutes. The Grizzlies rallied from 12 down with a 17–0 run to win. Cameron Boozer's 13 rebounds and 6 assists were a big part of the comeback. Golden State is 0–2 and 14th in the West, while Memphis is 2–0 and fifth.

recaps.keyLine: Sengun 29 pts, 7 reb, 7 ast · Thompson 20 pts, 10 reb, 4 ast · Wembanyama 25 pts, 13 reb, 2 ast · Harper 20 pts, 3 reb, 2 ast
recaps.text: Alperen Sengun led Houston, and the Rockets held on in the final seconds when Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama's last shot. Wembanyama had 25 points and 13 rebounds, and De'Aaron Fox added 9 assists. The Spurs are 0–2 and 13th in the West, and this loss makes the start harder to shake off. Houston is 2–0 and sixth.

recaps.keyLine: Williamson 23 pts, 5 reb, 2 ast, 3 stl · Bey 20 pts, 3 reb, 1 ast · Jackson Jr. 24 pts, 10 reb, 3 ast, 3 blk · George 19 pts, 1 reb, 10 ast
recaps.text: The Jazz won by one point. Jaren Jackson Jr. had 24 points, 10 rebounds and 3 blocks, and Keyonte George added 10 assists. Zion Williamson had 23 points for New Orleans, which is 0–2 and 12th in the West. Utah is 1–1 and eighth.

recaps.keyLine: Towns 22 pts, 10 reb, 3 ast · Anunoby 20 pts, 10 reb, 8 ast · Tatum 36 pts, 9 reb, 7 ast, 3 stl · George 15 pts, 7 reb, 2 ast
recaps.text: Jayson Tatum carried Boston with 36 points, 9 rebounds and 7 assists. OG Anunoby had 20 points, 10 rebounds and 8 assists for New York, but the Knicks could not stop Tatum late. The Celtics are 1–1 and seventh in the East, and the Knicks are 0–2 and 12th.
